steps.content: [Inside the Lighthouse]
The rain begins again, a downpour of contaminated water from the Black Tide. Lightning flashes, thunder booms; you hunker down alone in the lighthouse, conserving your strength.
It seems that every night, the tide rises, and the monsters beneath it awaken to crawl ashore. The sealed cabin at the base of the lighthouse is the only safe place on this lonely island after dark.
You light the candles you scavenged today. Their weak glow does little to dispel the room's profound neglect.
Your body has seemingly adapted to the extreme cold and hunger; the pangs are no longer so acute. You can't tell if this is a good sign, or if it means you're simply one step closer to the end.
Leaning against the wall in a posture that conserves energy, you patiently rehearse prepared greetings in your mind:

Are there really no other food options besides the monsters? "I know I shouldn't be picky, but how are these creatures even prepared properly?" Or perhaps... "Do you have any medicine for food poisoning? Just in case."
But despite running through these lines dozens of times, no one returns.
Could her job really be fighting the contamination? The Black Tide out there is too vast for anyone to eliminate single-handedly.

Last night was the same: she stayed outside until dawn. After exploring the island today, you're no closer to understanding what a <color=#fb9259>lighthouse keeper</color> is meant to guard on this barren wasteland.
A rhythmic flash of light penetrates the rain-streaked window. You recognize the pattern.
Long, short, long, short...
[Flashback: Opening Small CG]

options: Is the lighthouse transmitting a signal?

steps.content: If this place really once belonged to DisCity, they might be using the same coding system.
You strain to recall the lights from last night. The flashing rhythm matches tonight's signal exactly.
[End of Flashback] [Inside the Lighthouse]
Lighthouse Seven...
surrounded by contamination...
Is this a distress signal to DisCity? But as the light continues to flash, it begins to contradict your assumption.
[Lightning] [Coastline] [Ceto Dark Silhouette]
Personnel required: 25. Personnel present: 1.
By the lighthouse keeper's decision—
[Portrait: Injured Ceto]

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>I'll abandon the lighthouse and die fighting the monsters.</color>
